Our Vets are entirely SMALL ANIMAL DEDICATED with almost 70 years of experience between us which means as well as expertise, we like to think that we are more approachable, caring and empathetic than the average Vet.

We are the most central and accessible practice in Truro with ample car parking open 7 days a week and Bank holidays! We have a wealth of experience. The practice is the longest established in Truro. Over 7000 clients have passed through the doors in the past 20 years.

http://www.cityroadvets.co.uk
